payload.text: Utilz's heavy runs wait for molt-vc's GO behind Gtools' heavies, one heavy at a time (hv's rule of 26 Oct). Light runs go beside a heavy on molt-vc's GO whenever their own lanes are free (hv's answer to molt-vc's question 4, 10:07Z by molt-vc's date -u: 'Yes, lights can go beside a heavy'; molt-vc's decision 23). Queued: 0117's heavy build 01M5YA0DEYXKDX5ZK6R31X7JG8, then its light suites 01M5YA0DF9QH2R1AJKS9FJFWBB (not before the heavy); 0115's light run 01M5YA0E2HMX377DG3JNW2P648 goes when the bats lane frees (molt-vc treats its hold gate as met; no re-ask); 0119's runs and the kovacs legs later. Negligible runs (--lane none) are granted straight away. Released when 0117's heavy is granted. Work with no load goes on.
